Subject: Post-call: Compliance next steps — SOC2, GDPR/HIPAA, IR & BCP evidence

Hi Julia & Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on what you asked for: 

- You asked for our current SOC 2 Type II report (or pointer to it).
- You need confirmation on GDPR/HIPAA coverage for the data flows discussed (particularly EHR-related data and EU residency options).
- You requested our incident response (IR) and breach notification timelines and any evidence of past tabletop exercises / BCP/DR artifacts.
- You provided an initial vendor checklist and asked if we can start filling it and provide supporting attachments.

Actions I'm proposing from Redwood: 
1) Karthik will kick off filling the Vendor Security Questionnaire we prepared for you (attached). Expect an initial pass in ~10 business days.
2) Neha will pull our SOC2 report and BCP/DR evidence (RTO/RPO statements, recent tabletop dates). We’ll flag anything that is sensitive and provide redacted artifacts where appropriate.
3) I will coordinate legal for the DPA/contract redlines and send a DocuSign link for the DPA once procurement confirms the contact.

Could you confirm the person on your side who should receive the questionnaire and BCP evidence (Tom, is that you?), and confirm whether you need an explicit statement of our breach notification SLA (e.g., initial notification within X hours)?

Attaching: Vendor-Security-Questionnaire-MS-2025.xlsx (spreadsheet answers template)

Thanks — I’ll send a short checklist for our internal owners to track progress.

—Laura

- Attaching our latest SOC 2 Type II we have on file for vendors: MedSys_SOC2_Type2_2024.pdf (see attachment).
- For GDPR/HIPAA: we need confirmation that Redwood supports EU data residency for patient-identifiable data, and clarification on your data processing addendum scope.

Julia, Tom — thanks, and appreciate the quick turnaround on the SOC2. I started a draft of the questionnaire (will attach our internal IR playbook excerpt). Two clarifications so we can target the right artifacts: 

1) For EU data residency, we support model routing to EU regions for hosted accounts and can provide architecture diagrams + contracts showing where data at rest is stored. If you want an explicit data flow for the EHR use case, send an example dataset or outline and we’ll map it.

2) Breach notification windows: Redwood's standard practice is initial customer notification within 72 hours of confirmed breach detection for incidents that affect customer data confidentiality/integrity. For high-severity incidents (production compromise with exfiltration), we escalate immediately via phone and follow-up within 24 hours with technical details and mitigation steps. We will provide a formal statement for procurement to include in the SOW/DPA.

3) Tabletop/testing: we ran a company-wide tabletop in Jan 2025 and an infra-level failover exercise in Sep 2024; Neha is pulling the after-action summaries and timelines.

I’m attaching a short excerpt from our IR playbook that outlines detection -> initial triage -> customer notification flow. Expect the completed questionnaire first pass by 2025-06-04.

Attachments: Redwood-IR-Playbook.pdf

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-call: Compliance next steps — SOC2, GDPR/HIPAA, IR & BCP evidence

Thanks Laura & Karthik. A couple of follow-ups from security intake: 

- The procurement team will expect the Vendor Security Questionnaire returned populated and signed where indicated. We need the SOC2 and the IR timeline artifacts (detection -> notification windows) in writing for our records.
- Please confirm tokenization/encryption in transit & at rest and include key management details (KMS/HSM provider).
- We require a statement of your retention policy for logs (audit logs) and whether full request/response bodies are stored and for how long.
- For breach notification, our standard requirement is: initial notification to MedSys Security within 24 hours of confirmed customer-impacting breach detection, with a 72-hour detailed update. Can Redwood comply with that contract language or provide an alternate SLA?

Procurement contact is procurement@medsys.com — please route the DPA and any contract redlines there.

Attached: MedSys_Vendor_Security_Checklist_filled.pdf (our intake form partially completed for Redwood)

—Tom Ellis
Senior Director, Information Security
MedSys Health
